gobardhan.name: GOBARdhan (Galvanizing Organic Bio-Agro Resources Dhan)
gobardhan.description: Government umbrella initiative covering CBG, Bio-CNG, SATAT, and organic bio-fertilizer commercialization.
important_sources: PIB Ministry of Petroleum & Natural Gas
Ministry of New and Renewable Energy

samudra_manthan.name: Samudra Manthan (National Offshore Exploration Scheme)
samudra_manthan.description: Government umbrella initiative covering deepwater and ultra-deepwater oil and gas exploration, OALP block development, seismic surveys, and offshore drilling.
important_sources: PIB Ministry of Petroleum & Natural Gas

PRAJIND.NS.name: Praj Industries
PRAJIND.NS.mapping_rationale: Leading technology provider for 1G/2G ethanol, CBG (Compressed Bio-Gas), and brewery plants.

TRUALT.NS.name: TruAlt Bioenergy
TRUALT.NS.mapping_rationale: Largest ethanol producer in India; major CBG plant setup under SATAT scheme.

IONEXCHANG.NS.name: Ion Exchange
IONEXCHANG.NS.mapping_rationale: Water treatment and effluent management for bio-CNG plants; Gobardhan slurry handling.

WABAG.NS.name: VA Tech Wabag
WABAG.NS.mapping_rationale: Municipal and industrial wastewater-to-energy projects; biogas generation from sewage.

KIRLPNU.NS.name: Kirloskar Pneumatic
KIRLPNU.NS.mapping_rationale: Gas compressors for CNG/CBG booster stations, essential for SATAT grid injection.

GAIL.NS.name: GAIL (India)
GAIL.NS.mapping_rationale: National gas grid operator; mandated CBG offtake under SATAT; setting up 500+ CBG plants.

IOC.NS.name: Indian Oil Corporation
IOC.NS.mapping_rationale: Largest OMC with CBG offtake agreements (IndiGreen brand); SATAT commercial offtake.

ONGC.NS.name: Oil and Natural Gas Corporation
ONGC.NS.mapping_rationale: Primary national E&P operator leading deepwater offshore development (KG-DWN-98/2, Mumbai High, Andaman basin) and primary beneficiary of offshore exploration incentives.

OIL.NS.name: Oil India Limited
OIL.NS.mapping_rationale: National upstream exploration company expanding offshore drilling footprint in Andaman, Mahanadi, and Kerala-Konkan offshore blocks.

RELIANCE.NS.name: Reliance Industries
RELIANCE.NS.mapping_rationale: Pioneer in Indian ultra-deepwater gas production in the KG-D6 basin in partnership with bp; key stakeholder in deepwater infrastructure.

VEDL.NS.name: Vedanta Limited
VEDL.NS.mapping_rationale: Operates upstream exploration through Cairn Oil & Gas; holds significant acreage in OALP offshore blocks including Cambay, Ravva, and offshore exploratory tracts.
